Direct constructor result is non-null; status0 loads and validates the out value, nonzero builds Err without validating an absent output. Native reference registerCurrent excludes affine declarations and only seeds kind1; registerNamedBoxes correctly includes affine kind9, so its catalog count differs and metadata signature registration returns InvalidSource. Keep CSharp struct-before-enum/box ordering, complete catalogs, cache validation and diagnostics; no cache disabling or synthesized fallback identity.
